title: Povo - Polo Ferrari geographic blockout v0.1
horizontal_crs_label: EPSG:25832 per PAT tile index; source lineage ETRF2000 epoch 2008.0 / ETRS89
vertical_datum: ITALGEO 2005 orthometric metres per PAT metadata

attribution.terrain_and_building_heights: Derived from LiDAR DTM/DBM PAT 2014 / 2018, Provincia Autonoma di Trento - Servizio Geologico, CC BY 4.0. Cropped, subsampled, translated to local coordinates; building roof heights summarized and volumes approximated.
attribution.orthophoto: Comune di Trento, Ortofoto 2024, flight 28-29 August 2024, CC0 1.0 Universal. Resampled WMS extract used for geographic reference and approximate roof-envelope tracing.

note: A 200 x 300 m survey blockout containing a compact east-forecourt Wingman envelope. Rectangular modules approximate roof envelopes inspected in the 2024 municipal orthophoto and PAT DBM. These are not cadastral footprints or architectural measurements. Courtyard gaps are retained. Heights summarize mixed-date roof surfaces; base levels are buried construction assumptions. The bridge slab thickness is assumed. Gameplay cover and boundaries are explicit design additions rather than measured campus features. No interiors, openings, stairs or CS2 entities are authored here.

boundary.reason: Segmented perimeter walls make the first-playable east forecourt explicit and follow the sloping DTM without creating one oversized floating wall.

cover.reason: Full-height cover interrupts the western south-to-site sightline.
Low cover supports a second eastern approach without duplicating the western lane.
Central chest-height cover creates a disengagement point before the objective.
Offset central cover prevents a direct spawn-to-spawn sightline through the east lane.
Low cover mirrors the south-east option while preserving asymmetric terrain.
Full-height cover interrupts the eastern north-to-site sightline.

architecture.assumptions: Exterior detail pass based on user-reviewed photographs. Existing approximate module footprints and DBM roof heights are retained. Cardinal facade assignment, exact bay counts, window dimensions and floor levels are design estimates, not measurements. Opaque panel placeholders do not create breakable glass or access to interiors. The bridge roof follows the previous DBM estimate; its deck is estimated 3.2 m below the roof.

bridge.placement_note: Replace the old solid reference slab with a visual deck, roof, posts and horizontal louvers. Roof elevation follows the existing DBM estimate; deck, clearance and structural spacing are assumptions. This is scenery outside arena collision, not a verified accessible route.
